comparison.objective: Open a laptop and type “hello world”; candidate commissions a mechanical damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Laptop work tests lid articulation and sequential key pressing. Candidate tests hex-key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, tightening, and dynamic-response interpretation.
comparison.success_condition: Stated success is an opened laptop with the requested text typed; candidate requires repeated safe stopping and post-lock stability.
comparison.reason: Setup and scoring are missing, but computer operation is meaningfully different from physical damper tuning.
